_about: Abbie Farwell Brown's (1871-1927) The Book of Saints and Friendly Beasts: legends of saints and the animals in their stories, retold for children. Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto). Batch 22 (2026-10-03) adds In the Days of Giants: A Book of Norse Tales (copyright 1902) and The Curious Book of Birds (published October 1903), her retellings of Norse myth and of bird legends.
